blocks.text: 10. The Wheel of Fortune
The Eternal Cycle
Numbered ten, The Wheel of Fortune hangs in the sky, marking the completion of the first cycle of the Major Arcana.
Unlike the previous cards which focused on individual archetypes, this card represents the impersonal forces of destiny.
It is the machine of the universe, constantly turning, grinding out the cycles of life, death, and rebirth.
It teaches that nothing in the material world is permanent; the only constant is change itself.
The Center of the Storm
The wheel spins, but its center remains still.
This represents the duality of existence: the chaotic flux of the external world versus the serene stability of the inner self.
Those who cling to the rim of the wheel are dizzy with the highs and lows of fortune, rising one moment and falling the next.
However, those who find their way to the hub—the spiritual center—can observe the drama of life without being crushed by it.
The card asks you to find your axis amidst the turning world.
The Agents of Karma
Around the wheel sit three figures: the Sphinx atop, Anubis rising, and Typhon descending.
They symbolize the three states of fortune: ruling, rising, and falling.
They remind us that success is not a permanent state but a phase, just as failure is not a final destination but a transition.
This is the law of Karma in motion—what goes up must come down, and every action sets the wheel in motion for a corresponding reaction.
The Guardians of the Elements
In the four corners of the card sit the four living creatures mentioned in the vision of Ezekiel: the Angel, the Eagle, the Lion, and the Bull.
They represent the four fixed signs of the zodiac (Aquarius, Scorpio, Leo, Taurus) and the four elements.
They are engaged in study, reading the Torah, suggesting that while fortune may seem random, it is actually governed by divine law.
They stand outside the wheel, witnessing the drama of time from the perspective of eternity.
An Invitation to Surrender
Drawing The Wheel of Fortune is a call to surrender to the rhythm of the universe.
It asks you to stop resisting the changes that are sweeping through your life and to trust that the wheel is turning you toward your destiny.
It invites you to let go of the illusion of control and to ride the waves of fate with grace, knowing that winter always turns to spring.
